title: Helicity as quantised topological charge
html:
Remark. Helicity as quantised topological charge

The conservation of categorical helicity physically manifests topological charge conservation within the fluid. Smooth evolution cannot alter the total helicity of a vortex configuration. It merely redistributes helicity among writhe, twist, and linking, as demonstrated by trefoil chirality flips.

The exact quantisation of \Gamma_i^{(q)} = [j_i]_q[j_i+1]_q mandates that each term in the helicity sum remains individually quantised. Consequently, helicity is restricted to a discrete lattice structured by the \mathrm{SU}_q(2) representation labels \{j_i\}.
